preconditions.description: Attacker must have MINTER_ROLE or DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (which can grant MINTER_ROLE)

exploit_hint: If attacker has MINTER_ROLE, directly call mint() function to mint tokens to their address. If attacker has DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE but not MINTER_ROLE, first grant MINTER_ROLE to themselves using grantRole(), then call mint(). The minted tokens can be sold on Uniswap for profit via the existing pair.
